segments.hook_line: He bought the sunrise and put a price on dawn.
segments.script: He bought the sunrise and put a price on dawn. A wealthy merchant sealed a paper claiming the eastern sky. He built high grey walls along the mountain path. Anyone who wished to watch the morning had to drop copper coins into his iron bowl. Even as dark shadows stretched over the valley, his daughter pleaded with him to stop. He ignored her, pulled the heavy oak door shut, and locked out the cold world. If someone claimed the light above your home, would you pay?
